catalyst.description: NVIDIA announces a next-gen data-center GPU

article.headline: NVIDIA unveils Blackwell B200 at GTC 2024
article.summary: At its GTC keynote on March 18, 2024, NVIDIA announced the Blackwell B200 GPU and GB200 Superchip for data centers, succeeding the Hopper generation.

catalyst.description: NVIDIA announces a next-gen data-center GPU

article.headline: Analysts expect NVIDIA could reveal a new GPU at GTC
article.summary: Ahead of GTC, analysts speculated that NVIDIA might unveil a new data-center chip, but the company had announced no product.

catalyst.description: Google reaches a definitive agreement to acquire Wiz

article.headline: Alphabet to acquire Wiz for $32 billion
article.summary: Alphabet announced a definitive agreement on March 18, 2025 to acquire cloud-security firm Wiz for $32 billion in an all-cash deal.

catalyst.description: Google reaches a definitive agreement to acquire Wiz

article.headline: Google in talks to buy Wiz, sources say
article.summary: People familiar with the matter said in 2024 that Google was in talks to acquire Wiz for about $23 billion; the talks later fell through with no agreement.

catalyst.description: Boeing wins the US Air Force NGAD (F-47) fighter contract

article.headline: Trump awards Boeing the Air Force's next-generation fighter contract
article.summary: On March 21, 2025 the White House and US Air Force announced that Boeing won the Next Generation Air Dominance program, designated the F-47.

catalyst.description: Boeing wins the US Air Force NGAD (F-47) fighter contract

article.headline: Boeing seen as frontrunner for NGAD, sources say
article.summary: Two people briefed on the matter said Boeing was expected to win the NGAD contract, though no official award had been announced.

catalyst.description: Apple acquires Perplexity AI

article.headline: Apple executives discussed bidding for Perplexity, report says
article.summary: Bloomberg reported that Apple executives had internally discussed a potential bid for Perplexity AI; the talks were described as early-stage and might not lead to an offer.

catalyst.description: Apple acquires Perplexity AI

article.headline: Perplexity says it has no knowledge of Apple acquisition talks
article.summary: A Perplexity spokesperson said the company had no knowledge of any current or future acquisition discussions involving Apple.

catalyst.description: Meta initiates its first-ever dividend

article.headline: Meta declares first-ever dividend and authorizes $50B buyback
article.summary: On February 1, 2024 Meta declared its first quarterly dividend of $0.50 per share and authorized $50 billion in share repurchases.

catalyst.description: FDA approves Eli Lilly's Zepbound for weight management

article.headline: FDA approves Lilly's Zepbound for chronic weight management
article.summary: The FDA approved Eli Lilly's Zepbound (tirzepatide) for chronic weight management on November 8, 2023.

catalyst.description: Apple authorizes a new share buyback

article.headline: Apple authorizes $110 billion buyback and raises dividend
article.summary: On May 2, 2024 Apple's board authorized an additional $110 billion in share repurchases and raised its dividend by 4%.

catalyst.description: NVIDIA announces a stock split

article.headline: NVIDIA announces 10-for-1 stock split
article.summary: In its May 22, 2024 earnings release NVIDIA announced a 10-for-1 forward stock split effective June 7, 2024, and raised its dividend.

catalyst.description: Microsoft completes its acquisition of Activision Blizzard

article.headline: Microsoft closes $69 billion Activision Blizzard acquisition
article.summary: Microsoft completed its acquisition of Activision Blizzard on October 13, 2023 after receiving UK regulatory clearance.

catalyst.description: Skydance completes its merger with Paramount

article.headline: Skydance and Paramount complete merger
article.summary: Skydance and Paramount Global completed their merger on August 7, 2025; the combined company began trading as Paramount Skydance.

catalyst.description: Kroger completes its merger with Albertsons

article.headline: Judge blocks Kroger-Albertsons merger
article.summary: On December 10, 2024 a federal judge blocked Kroger's proposed $25 billion merger with Albertsons; the deal was subsequently terminated.

catalyst.description: JetBlue completes its acquisition of Spirit

article.headline: Judge blocks JetBlue's acquisition of Spirit on antitrust grounds
article.summary: On January 16, 2024 a federal judge blocked JetBlue's $3.8 billion acquisition of Spirit Airlines; the companies terminated the deal in March 2024.

catalyst.description: Tapestry completes its acquisition of Capri

article.headline: Court blocks Tapestry's acquisition of Capri
article.summary: On October 24, 2024 a federal judge granted the FTC's request to block Tapestry's $8.5 billion acquisition of Capri.

catalyst.description: Pfizer's oral obesity pill danuglipron advances toward approval

article.headline: Pfizer discontinues oral obesity pill danuglipron
article.summary: On April 14, 2025 Pfizer said it discontinued development of danuglipron after a trial participant showed a potential drug-induced liver injury.

catalyst.description: NVIDIA announces a new share buyback

article.headline: NVIDIA posts record data-center revenue on AI demand
article.summary: NVIDIA reported record quarterly data-center revenue driven by AI demand, beating analyst estimates.

catalyst.description: Amazon acquires an AI model company

article.headline: Amazon invests another $4 billion in Anthropic
article.summary: Amazon said on November 22, 2024 it would invest an additional $4 billion in Anthropic, bringing its total to $8 billion, while remaining a minority investor with no board seat.

catalyst.description: Kroger completes its merger with Albertsons

article.headline: Kroger announces $7.5 billion share buyback
article.summary: After its merger with Albertsons was blocked, Kroger announced a $7.5 billion share repurchase program in December 2024.
